title: The Price Effect of Michigan's 2026 Fuel Tax Reform
abstract: On 1 January 2026, Michigan replaced its 6% fuel sales tax with a flat per-gallon tax. Using daily retail gasoline price data at the city level and employing a difference-in-differences approach, we find that this policy change initially led to an approximately 4 cents-per-gallon increase in average fuel prices at the pump during January and February, implying about 72% pass-through of the tax to consumers. There is heterogeneity in the initial effect across locations, with evidence suggesting that the burden fell more heavily on areas with a larger share of commuting motorists. Following the disruption in global oil supply in early March 2026, the new flat fuel tax should, in principle, have provided consumers with more financial relief than the prior variable 6% tax, although our results imply that these gains were slow to set in.
abstract_zh: 2026年1月1日，密歇根州将其6%的燃油销售税改为按加仑计征的统一税。利用城市层面的每日零售汽油价格数据，并采用双重差分方法，我们发现，该政策调整在最初的1月和2月使加油站的平均燃油价格上涨了约每加仑4美分，这意味着税负约有72%向消费者转嫁。不同地区的初始效应存在异质性，有证据表明，通勤驾车者比例较高的地区承担了更重的负担。2026年3月全球石油供应中断之后，新的统一燃油税原则上应比先前按6%计征的可变税为消费者提供更多的经济缓解，但我们的结果表明，这些收益的显现较为缓慢。

Tax Holidays and the Heterogeneous Pass-Through of Gasoline Taxes
abstract: The pass-through of gasoline taxes to retail prices plays a vital role in determining the extent to which a fuel tax suspension policy provides financial relief to consumers. Given the increased interest in utilizing such “tax holidays” to mitigate the unprecedented rise of gasoline prices in 2022, it is important to obtain location-specific pass-through estimates that will inform future similar policy efforts. Using daily city-level data from a sample of 108 cities in 15 East Coast states and the District of Columbia during the period February 1, 2022-June 30, 2022, I estimate an average pass-through rate of gasoline taxes of 79%. My subsequent analysis reveals heterogeneity in pass-through across locations and explores supply constraints, market isolation, and spillover effects as possible contributing factors to this heterogeneity.
abstract_zh: 汽油税向零售价格的传导，在很大程度上决定了燃油税暂停政策能在多大程度上为消费者提供经济缓解。鉴于人们对利用此类“税收假期”来缓解2022年汽油价格前所未有的上涨日益感兴趣，获得能够为未来类似政策提供参考的、基于地点的传导估计非常重要。我利用2022年2月1日至6月30日期间，来自东海岸15个州和哥伦比亚特区108个城市的每日城市层面数据，估计得出汽油税的平均传导率为79%。随后的分析揭示了不同地点之间传导的异质性，并探讨了供给约束、市场隔离和溢出效应作为导致这种异质性的可能因素。

The Effectiveness of a Water Right Retirement Program at Conserving Water
abstract: This study employs a difference-in-differences framework to assess the effectiveness of the 2008–2012 pilot phase of the Kansas Water Right Transition Assistance Program at reducing either groundwater or surface water use. We distinguish between two program components: creek subbasins and designated High Priority Areas. Results demonstrate that water right retirement in the High Priority Areas substantially reduced groundwater use. Regardless of the program component, we find no effect on surface water use. Our conclusions are robust to various specifications. This study is the first to directly estimate the effect of water right retirement or any form of restriction on irrigation-related water rights. (JEL Q15, Q28)
abstract_zh: 本研究采用双重差分框架，评估了2008至2012年堪萨斯水权转让援助计划试点阶段在减少地下水或地表水使用方面的有效性。我们区分了该计划的两个组成部分：溪流子流域和指定的高优先区（High Priority Areas）。结果表明，高优先区的水权退出显著减少了地下水的使用。无论属于哪一项计划组成部分，我们均未发现其对地表水使用有影响。我们的结论在各种设定下都是稳健的。本研究首次直接估计了水权退出或任何形式的灌溉相关水权限制的效果。（JEL Q15, Q28）

title: Hurdles and Steps: Estimating Demand for Solar Photovoltaics
abstract: This paper estimates demand for residential solar photovoltaic (PV) systems using a new approach to address three empirical challenges that often arise with count data: excess zeros, unobserved heterogeneity, and endogeneity of price. Our results imply a price elasticity of demand for solar PV systems of -0 65.Counterfactual policy simulations indicate that reducing state financial incentives in half would have led to 9% fewer new installations in Connecticut in 2014.Calculations suggest a subsidy program cost of $364/tCO 2 assuming solar displaces natural gas. Our Poisson hurdle approach holds promise for modeling the demand for many new technologies.
abstract_zh: 本文采用一种新方法估计住宅太阳能光伏（PV）系统的需求，以应对计数数据中经常出现的三个实证挑战：过多的零值、不可观测的异质性以及价格的内生性。我们的结果意味着太阳能光伏系统的需求价格弹性为-0.65。反事实政策模拟表明，若将州政府财政激励减半，2014年康涅狄格州的新增装机量将减少9%。计算表明，假设太阳能取代天然气，补贴计划的成本为每吨CO2 364美元。我们的泊松跨栏（Poisson hurdle）方法有望用于对许多新技术的需求进行建模。

title: Climate Change and Land Use in Southeastern U.S.: Did the 'Dumb Farmer' Get It Wrong?
abstract: The assumption of a fixed amount of land remaining in agriculture regardless of changing climate conditions — one of the features of the “dumb farmer scenario” — is likely to bias the estimated social welfare impacts of climate change. In order to quantify this bias, we employ a demand-supply framework to determine both the amount of land allocated to agricultural and nonagricultural uses as well as the social welfare associated with this allocation choice when no market distortions exist. We present an application of our model to the Southeastern United States and simulate the effects of changing climate conditions on land allocation in the region between 2007 and 2040. We find a very modest welfare bias when maintaining current farmland preservation policies and a more substantial bias if we assume that additional land policies are instituted which have spillover welfare effects in other land-using sectors.
abstract_zh: “固定农地面积”假设，即无论气候条件如何变化，农业用地面积都保持不变，这是“笨农民情景”的特征之一，它可能会使对气候变化社会福利影响的估计产生偏差。为量化这种偏差，我们采用供需框架，在不存在市场扭曲的情况下，确定用于农业和非农业用途的土地面积，以及该土地配置选择所对应的社会福利。我们将模型应用于美国东南部，模拟了2007至2040年间气候条件变化对该地区土地配置的影响。我们发现，在维持现行农地保护政策的情况下，偏差非常小；而如果假设还实施了会对其他土地利用部门产生溢出福利效应的额外土地政策，偏差则更为显著。
